summary: Cabaletta Bio filed an Item 8.01 8-K disclosing the final exercise results for 53,090,190 common stock warrants issued in its June 2025 underwritten public offering, struck at $2.50 per whole share with a September 12, 2026 expiration. Exercises totaled 5,275,100 warrants through June 30, 2026 ($13.2 million) and 46,011,900 from July 1 through expiration ($115.0 million), aggregating roughly $128.2 million gross proceeds. This is a routine capital-raising update, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms were disclosed. Watch warrant-driven share overhang and resulting cash runway.
